description: A board's Fix list for a range, ranked by visitors affected: slow Core Web Vitals, sites that send nobody onward, sites most visitors leave after one page, low conversion, falling traffic, untagged social campaigns, and setup gaps (no goal, no Speed Insights, no Web Analytics). Each item has its kind, site, title, detail, why it matters and how to verify a fix. status: open (default), snoozed or resolved.

board.description: A board's id from list_boards (a UUID), or its exact name

anyOf.description: A custom window of whole UTC days, 1 to 30 days, ending today at the latest

range.description: 24h, 7d or 30d, or a custom window { "from": "YYYY-MM-DD", "to": "YYYY-MM-DD" } (UTC days, up to 30). Default 7d.

name: list_fixes
title: List what to fix
